# Release notes
- **Simpler composer on Mac and iOS:** One button now switches between Send, Stop, Steer and Queue as the conversation changes, keeping the controls compact. - **More reliable dictation:** Fixed an issue that could cut off the final words when stopping a recording. - **Improved iPhone dictation layout:** The waveform appears beneath your prompt, keeping the microphone and send controls in place. - **Smoother mobile transitions:** Settings, New Chat, Files and Settled now expand from their buttons. Model selection and smaller control animations also feel more consistent and respect Reduce Motion. - **Easier attachments on iOS:** The attachment button opens a compact popover for choosing Photos or Files. - **Better Mac conversation spacing:** Pinning the activity card adjusts the transcript and composer to make room beside them.

## Controller 1.0.9
- Improved transcript scrolling, streaming follow behavior, and conversation transitions. - Refined workspace, browser, Files, and inspector navigation and lifecycle handling. - Improved provider session handling and live context usage reporting. - Strengthened background persistence and process cleanup.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 27 or later.

Controller 1.0.8 updates agent controls and makes model selection more consistent across Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
- Choose models, reasoning effort, speed, and provider options from one expanding model card. - Use additional native Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, and OpenCode conversation controls. - Keep a started conversation on its account while allowing account selection for new work. - Manage background work from the activity card and let agents manage threads and worktrees. - Improve provider usage reporting and shared remote controls.
Requires macOS 27 and Apple silicon. Coding tools are installed separately.
